title: Demonstration 2: scATAC-seq Simulation Evaluation
text: Single-cell assay transposase-accessible chromatin sequencing (scATAC-seq) measures chromatin accessibility single-cell resolution. title: scSimEval: Unified Benchmarking for Single-Cell Multiomics Simulations
text: scSimEval organizes 62 evaluation measures eight foundational categories: Category 1: Distribution Properties (14 metrics) — Compares single-cell count distributions (library size, average expression, gene variance, zero fraction) data manifolds real simulated data using statistical distance measures (Kolmogorov-Smirnov, Wasserstein, Median Absolute Deviation, RMSE, Density Overlap, Bhattacharyya distance, ECDF area, Runs test, Maximum Mean Discrepancy, Fréchet distance). Category 2: Correlations Zero Patterns (8 metrics) — Checks biological variation, dropout curves, cell--cell correlations, gene-gene co-expression relationships. Category 3: Cell Structure Clustering (9 metrics) — Evaluates whether simulated data preserves distinct cell types unsupervised clustering (Silhouette width, Dunn index, Davies-Bouldin, Calinski-Harabasz) supervised group matching (Adjusted Rand Index, Normalized Mutual Information, VV-measure, Neighborhood Purity, Hungarian matching accuracy). Category 4: Batch Effects Technical Confounders (6 metrics) — Tests whether technical batch differences well-mixed without erasing true biological differences (CellMixS, batch Shannon entropy, Principal Component Regression R2R^2, Seurat mixing metric, LISI, cross-batch cell prediction accuracy). Category 5: Marker Genes Biological Signals (15 metrics) — Assesses differentially expressed gene (DEG) fidelity across three established benchmarking frameworks: Simpipe, SimBench, Shaky Foundations (effect size errors, fold-change correlations, top-marker overlap, cell classification accuracy). Category 6: Trajectory Lineage Dynamics (2 metrics) — Evaluates developmental timelines (pseudotime rank correlation) cell lineage tree branching (branch height RMSE), inferred directly scRNA-seq counts. Category 7: Cross-Modal Coupling Modularity (6 metrics) — Evaluates connection chromatin accessibility gene expression multiomics data, including cell--cell matching (FOSCTTM, Match@1), cross-modal cell type transfer, peak--gene regulatory links (RVR_V coefficient). Category 8: Computer Resources Scalability (2 metrics) — Measures total execution time seconds peak computer memory usage MiB.

text: ensure fair comparison across metrics different units directions: Direction Inversion (Lower--Better Metrics): Metrics smaller numbers denote superior fidelity (KS distance, Wasserstein distance, RMSE, runtime) inverted: Inverted Value=Maximum−Value\text{Inverted Value} = \text{Maximum} - \text{Value} ensures larger values always denote superior quality across every measure.
